market_outlook.short_term: Markets face 1-3 month headwind from Fed hawkishness and signal of another hike. Expect volatility in equities, dollar strength, and rising bond yields. Oil stabilizes post-Middle East repairs. European stocks offer relative strength. Turkey and EM carry contagion risk. Consumer sector under pressure from 7% mortgage rates.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook moderately constructive if Fed pauses after next hike. AI capex cycle (Amazon, IBM, Intel) supports tech earnings. European bullishness has 8-year tailwind. Chinese yuan strength and Trump-Xi diplomacy reduce tariff risk. Key risk: if inflation proves sticky, multiple hikes compress valuations across growth sectors. Healthcare AI and copper/industrials offer structural growth.
